title: Ringg reports lower costs from routing customer-service work across models
friendlyTitle: Ringg shows how customer-service AI works at scale
summary: In an OpenAI customer case study, Ringg says its multilingual voice and chat agents handle more than seven million connected calls a month and resolve up to 65% of routine requests. The platform routes different tasks to different models, evaluates changes offline and escalates cases to people with context.
friendlySummary: Ringg says its AI handles millions of calls and chats each month. It uses different models for different jobs, tests changes before release and sends difficult cases to people.
whyItMatters: The useful lesson is architectural rather than promotional: production agents need model routing, evaluations, health monitoring, summaries and explicit human escalation. Businesses assessing service automation should examine the full operating system around the model, not just a demo.
friendlyWhyItMatters: A reliable AI service needs checks, backups and a clear way to involve a human. The model alone is not the whole solution.
